changes: Removed native casts, mapped stack, OS crash/fault handling, JIT and external callbacks
Bounded instruction trace and structured stop reason
MIPS-I branch/load delays and trapping overflow; unsupported BIOS/MMIO/COP0 halt
No complete PS1 hardware, cycle timing or full-game claim
SYS(1/2) logical critical-section flag with previous-state return for Enter and register preservation for Exit; other system calls still halt. Initially enabled, no CP0 exceptions or IRQ delivery.
I_STAT/I_MASK register-only MMIO adapter: halfword/word aliases, 11-bit mask, zero-bit acknowledge semantics. No device edge generation, CP0 IRQ dispatch or scheduler.
